subject: general
question: Rinku travels 136 meters in his car in 17 seconds. Find his speed (in km/hr).
solution:
**Given:**

Distance traveled = 136 meters

Time taken = 17 seconds

**Formula used:**

Speed (km/hr) = dfrac{{distance (meters)}}{{time (seconds)}} times dfrac{18}{5}

**Calculations:**

Speed = dfrac{136}{17} times dfrac{18}{5}

⇒ Speed = (8) times dfrac{18}{5}

⇒ Speed = (144/5)

⇒ Speed = 28.8 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
